//product: The Blinkit product to track. prid is the number at the end of the URL.
//location: Your coords are SECRET (they reveal your home) -> set LAT / LON in the .env file, NOT here. locality is only a non-sensitive hint.
//notify: Your ntfy topic is SECRET (it is the only password on free ntfy.sh) -> set NTFY_TOPIC in the .env file, NOT here. Optionally override the server with NTFY_SERVER.

notify.//remindEveryMinutes: Keep nagging while it stays IN STOCK: re-ping at most every N minutes. 0 = only alert on the out->in-stock transition. Checks run every ~11-13 min, so any value below ~10 effectively means 'ping on every check'.
notify.//heartbeatHour: Send one low-priority 'still watching' push per day at/after this hour (local time; set TZ in docker-compose). -1 disables. If you ever stop getting it, the tracker is dead.

//watch: Used only in --watch mode. intervalMinutes between checks; jitterSeconds randomizes timing a little so it does not look robotic.
//browser: Leave chromiumPath empty to use Playwright's bundled Chromium (recommended, and what the Docker image uses). On a bare machine where the bundled browser is missing/mismatched, set it to a system chromium, e.g. "/usr/bin/chromium". Or set env CHROMIUM_PATH.
